story.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows

draft:
I've been exploring Meta's new Muse Glimmer model and its potential for always-on local agent workflows. 
The 30B-parameter model is optimized for local deployment, reducing latency and improving performance. 
Key benefits include enhanced data privacy and reduced reliance on cloud services. 
What are the potential applications of this technology in your workflow?
